question: Roshan is the brother of Kripa, who is the son of Pranjal. Vaishnavi is the wife of Aayush. Pramila is the daughter of Devika. Devika is the grandmother of Aayush, who is the son of Roshan. How is Roshan related to Pramila?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0ce53162b8f319ceb328ee3cace8adccba14f9c1e6d2a07d025d791b4e9bdbd.png] 

Clearly, Roshan is brother of Pramila.

Hence, '**Brother**' is the correct answer.
